e6120de23354f129c554.en: Joining words link two ideas into one sentence.
e6120de23354f129c554.id: Kata penghubung (joining words) menyatukan dua ide menjadi satu kalimat.

3864162cf96c993a11e7.en: But shows a change or a problem.

96bfe3a2b6c5ed6ebe60.en: Because gives a reason. It answers why.
96bfe3a2b6c5ed6ebe60.id: Because memberi alasan. Kata ini menjawab pertanyaan why.

52888ad1c38a3fdedac6.en: So tells you what happened next.
52888ad1c38a3fdedac6.id: So memberi tahu apa yang terjadi selanjutnya.

fb8522e8ecd512c35e5d.en: So shows a result: I was thirsty, so I drank some water.
fb8522e8ecd512c35e5d.id: So menunjukkan akibat: I was thirsty, so I drank some water.

72113c1793b48502672a.en: Because gives a reason, but here the reason comes first.
72113c1793b48502672a.id: Because memberi alasan, tetapi di sini alasannya muncul lebih dulu.

9e90f504a6c1021bfd4f.en: Because gives the reason: I stayed at home because I was ill.
9e90f504a6c1021bfd4f.id: Because memberi alasan: I stayed at home because I was ill.

cf8a04cf754870a070ee.en: So would mean being ill was a result of staying home.
cf8a04cf754870a070ee.id: So akan berarti sakit itu akibat dari tinggal di rumah.

e9bdcc85e0c4f5c2e168.en: And adds more. Here we need a reason.
e9bdcc85e0c4f5c2e168.id: And menambahkan hal lain. Di sini kita perlu alasan.

b70766b9dd4662b1e2e2.en: And adds more: I like apples and pears.
b70766b9dd4662b1e2e2.id: And menambahkan hal lain: I like apples and pears.

82131e63179adfc322b6.en: But shows something different. Here we add more.
82131e63179adfc322b6.id: But menunjukkan hal yang berbeda. Di sini kita menambahkan hal lain.

a2787e3a1af5fcd25048.id: So menunjukkan apa yang terjadi berikutnya.

593f4d4252c09936d587.en: So tells us what happened because of the first part: I was hungry, so I ate a banana.
593f4d4252c09936d587.id: So memberi tahu apa yang terjadi karena bagian pertama: I was hungry, so I ate a banana.

643473f92806a1e7c929.en: But shows a surprise or a change.

110be202828da070ad50.en: Because gives a reason. Here the reason comes first.
110be202828da070ad50.id: Because memberi alasan. Di sini alasannya muncul lebih dulu.

929be8b9f1bd2aedcf77.en: But joins two ideas that clash: I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.
929be8b9f1bd2aedcf77.id: But menyambung dua ide yang berlawanan: I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.

db8d20f0552cc2eae192.en: So would mean the rain happened because you wanted to play.
db8d20f0552cc2eae192.id: So akan berarti hujan turun karena kamu ingin bermain.

0ec2e918b3dc71e0a0bf.en: Because would mean the rain was the reason you wanted to play.
0ec2e918b3dc71e0a0bf.id: Because akan berarti hujan itu alasan kamu ingin bermain.

277289966b5ed508f287.en: And adds more, but these two ideas clash.
277289966b5ed508f287.id: And menambahkan hal lain, tetapi dua hal ini berlawanan.

9eaf70f03b5170fceef0.en: Because gives a reason: We took umbrellas because it was raining.
9eaf70f03b5170fceef0.id: Because memberi alasan: We took umbrellas because it was raining.

445bd6eb4a9716600933.en: So would mean the rain came because of the umbrellas.
445bd6eb4a9716600933.id: So akan berarti hujan turun karena payung.

cb22650177ff07a6c2cb.en: Because gives a reason, so gives a result, but shows a difference and and adds more.
cb22650177ff07a6c2cb.id: Because memberi alasan, so memberi akibat, but menunjukkan perbedaan, dan and menambahkan hal lain.

c9dd2df05611e1e7f8a1.en: So shows a result: The shop was closed, so we went home.
c9dd2df05611e1e7f8a1.id: So menunjukkan akibat: The shop was closed, so we went home.

eb6fa9a40431493ef2be.en: Being happy is a reason to smile, and water is a reason a plant grows.
eb6fa9a40431493ef2be.id: Merasa senang adalah alasan untuk tersenyum, dan air adalah alasan tanaman tumbuh.

f75cddb8ce9802b245c6.en: Being sad is not a reason to be happy.
f75cddb8ce9802b245c6.id: Merasa sedih bukan alasan untuk merasa senang.

ad41137ed47991d68f94.en: Your hat does not make it sunny.
ad41137ed47991d68f94.id: Topimu tidak membuat cuaca jadi cerah.

ad0eda9ce2d311828582.en: But joins two different ideas: Rina likes to sing, but she does not like to dance.
ad0eda9ce2d311828582.id: But menyambung dua ide yang berbeda: Rina likes to sing, but she does not like to dance.

86f6a654b5eb3ca1994f.en: And adds more, but these ideas are different.
86f6a654b5eb3ca1994f.id: And menambahkan hal lain, tetapi hal-hal ini berbeda.

1f806e1f5b0326cd55c7.en: We stayed inside because it was raining. Because joins the reason to what happened.
1f806e1f5b0326cd55c7.id: We stayed inside because it was raining. Because menyambung alasan dengan apa yang terjadi.

f14fff9d9181ac748f6a.en: So shows a result. Being tired can make you go to bed early.
f14fff9d9181ac748f6a.id: So menunjukkan akibat. Rasa lelah bisa membuatmu tidur lebih awal.

b88af3b41c8aae686e35.en: Running a race is not a result of being tired.
b88af3b41c8aae686e35.id: Ikut lomba lari bukan akibat dari rasa lelah.

4157e274c665f8ae67c5.en: This does not follow from being tired.
4157e274c665f8ae67c5.id: Ini bukan akibat dari rasa lelah.

5fadc2df008c58aa16fd.en: Tired means you do not have lots of energy.
5fadc2df008c58aa16fd.id: Tired berarti kamu tidak punya banyak energi.

dc98e7e34b83e15819b4.en: Because gives the reason. Tripping on a stone made Ben fall.
dc98e7e34b83e15819b4.id: Because memberi alasan. Tersandung batu membuat Ben jatuh.

fbd020449bb871c34dd0.en: Getting a plaster happened after he fell.
fbd020449bb871c34dd0.id: Mendapat plester terjadi setelah dia jatuh.

85116dda86e4abaecb02.en: Going home happened after he fell.

69021a384a7d49442141.en: But joins two ideas that do not match: smelled good, but tasted bad.
69021a384a7d49442141.id: But menyambung dua ide yang tidak cocok: smelled good, but tasted bad.

5d0915416d82e9570504.en: And adds more. These ideas clash.
5d0915416d82e9570504.id: And menambahkan hal lain. Hal-hal ini berlawanan.

c7fe13ae14579ed923af.en: Rain and a broken pipe are reasons, so they go after because. Driving slowly and wearing boots are results, so they go after so.
c7fe13ae14579ed923af.id: Hujan dan pipa yang rusak adalah alasan, jadi keduanya ditulis setelah because. Menyetir pelan-pelan dan memakai sepatu bot adalah akibat, jadi keduanya ditulis setelah so.

9bbce935a4eab1a41d26.en: Because gives the reason: he was late because his car would not start.
9bbce935a4eab1a41d26.id: Because memberi alasan: he was late because his car would not start.

340bc7ac7647bbe95528.en: So would mean the car broke because he was late.
340bc7ac7647bbe95528.id: So akan berarti mobilnya rusak karena dia terlambat.

b4df72cbd78e1f976321.en: So shows a result: The dog was dirty, so we gave it a bath.
b4df72cbd78e1f976321.id: So menunjukkan akibat: The dog was dirty, so we gave it a bath.

01b368121649f5881586.en: A jumper does not make you cold, so that sentence does not make sense.
01b368121649f5881586.id: A jumper (baju hangat) tidak membuatmu kedinginan, jadi kalimat itu tidak masuk akal.

911e2aea675d368becb2.en: But shows the problem, and so shows what happened next.
911e2aea675d368becb2.id: But menunjukkan masalahnya, dan so menunjukkan apa yang terjadi berikutnya.

8a00d13d2fe236877f42.en: So and but are in the wrong places.
8a00d13d2fe236877f42.id: So dan but ada di tempat yang salah.

e4c9da4f8efbf8f3b638.en: Because does not fit the first gap.
e4c9da4f8efbf8f3b638.id: Because tidak cocok untuk bagian kosong pertama.

9f47d791ec99c14053a3.en: Because does not fit the second gap.
9f47d791ec99c14053a3.id: Because tidak cocok untuk bagian kosong kedua.

c9ee125da8a4b5caff98.en: And is a joining word. It links words and ideas together.
c9ee125da8a4b5caff98.id: And adalah kata penghubung (joining word). Kata ini menyambung kata dan ide.

cc6a08b00c1a953ceb62.en: I was tired, so I went to bed. The joining word so shows what happened because of the first idea.
cc6a08b00c1a953ceb62.id: I was tired, so I went to bed. Kata penghubung so menunjukkan apa yang terjadi karena ide pertama.

218b18835d79f27aaf6d.en: And joins the cat and the dog.

dd335137839e83323887.en: So shows the result of the rain.

45f5c12d0e1e2e29ad47.en: Because would give the reason the wrong way round.

3848d99c5c863e20795a.id: But menunjukkan dua ide yang berbeda.

74ebb73f98999b57e9c1.en: Because gives the reason Tia stayed home.
74ebb73f98999b57e9c1.id: Because memberi alasan Tia tinggal di rumah.

739066d236ca0e28be6d.en: So would make the sentence not make sense.
739066d236ca0e28be6d.id: So akan membuat kalimatnya tidak masuk akal.

f5fa089b4aa64943a7e1.en: Or gives a choice between two things.
f5fa089b4aa64943a7e1.id: Or memberi pilihan di antara dua hal.

a798d93f81043df069fc.en: I was hungry so I ate rice.
a798d93f81043df069fc.id: I was hungry so I ate rice.

a4aa920a66fe57858d71.en: Each joining word has its own job.
a4aa920a66fe57858d71.id: Setiap kata penghubung punya tugasnya sendiri.

c23aa25d4ae43ae66dfa.en: So shows the result: I put on a jumper.
c23aa25d4ae43ae66dfa.id: So menunjukkan akibat: I put on a jumper.

d5bd5fad2ebec4afb3de.en: Because gives the reason, but the jumper is the result.
d5bd5fad2ebec4afb3de.id: Because memberi alasan, tetapi jumper di sini adalah akibatnya.

2c33019316b6c187d0d7.en: But shows a difference, which does not fit here.
2c33019316b6c187d0d7.id: But menunjukkan perbedaan, dan itu tidak cocok di sini.

052032096ea6c604d6ba.en: But shows a surprise: small but strong.
052032096ea6c604d6ba.id: But menunjukkan hal yang mengejutkan: small but strong.

1350aeb2d68dcdcf2497.en: Because tells us why something happened. Example: I took my coat because it was cold.
1350aeb2d68dcdcf2497.id: Because memberi tahu mengapa sesuatu terjadi. Contoh: I took my coat because it was cold.

6635335c8783a9c85046.en: And joins two ideas that go together. Because is the word that gives a reason.
6635335c8783a9c85046.id: And menyambung dua ide yang sejalan. Because adalah kata yang memberi alasan.

475cc7d809e4fb9df75c.en: But shows a contrast. Example: I like tea but I do not like coffee.
475cc7d809e4fb9df75c.id: But menunjukkan perbedaan. Contoh: I like tea but I do not like coffee.

a669df9d3b7f109b9aaf.en: So tells us the result. Example: It was raining so we stayed inside.
a669df9d3b7f109b9aaf.id: So memberi tahu akibatnya. Contoh: It was raining so we stayed inside.

5e186df410dacdd8a31c.en: The words it was raining give the reason. The word because comes right before the reason.
5e186df410dacdd8a31c.id: Kata-kata it was raining memberi alasan. Kata because ditulis tepat sebelum alasan.

435aec7f6eb20c8c6a54.en: So joins a cause and its result. Tired is the cause. Going to bed is the result.
435aec7f6eb20c8c6a54.id: So menyambung sebab dan akibatnya. Tired adalah sebabnya. Going to bed adalah akibatnya.

6940808fad0c4c76f5ff.en: But joins two ideas that contrast.
6940808fad0c4c76f5ff.id: But menyambung dua ide yang berlawanan.
